source.review_note: Existing reviewed assembled-bike valve access/closure retained. Additional PDF92-95 and216-221 visually reviewed for shim selection, cam/tensioner removal, installation and timing recheck. Exact diagrams remain mandatory where flagged.

remaining_dependency_graph.reason: Head removal separates radiator hose. Exact drain, new seals, fill/air removal and final checks must be integrated.
Airbox/brackets, two throttle cables, fuel hose, sensors, joint clamp and throttle free play/return closure needed; do not silently omit these.
Upper bracket bolt34 N·m versus upper engine mounting bolt45 N·m distinguished; removal/support sequence and all bracket positions need closure.
Valves/guides/seats/springs remain outside completion; a head removal/refit is not a rebuilt head.

critical_reviewed_conditions.condition: Two M6x45 and four M10x129 bolts; follow removal diagram1–6, loosen each half a turn at a time before removing fully. Removal and installation numbering differ.

New head gasket with diagram orientation; retain dowels and intake chain guide. Clean bolt/washer/head contact faces and crankcase threads. Molybdenum disulfide GREASE on four main bolt threads/contact faces and both washer faces. First all four in source order to36 N·m in2–3 stages. Then REMOVE only bolt1, reapply grease and reinstall18 N·m plus90 degrees; complete that bolt before repeating bolts2–4. Then final additional60 degrees in order. The two small bolts5/6 are12 N·m with LOCTITE. Do not collapse this to36+90+60 or loosen all four together.

Warp limit0.05 mm. Source includes resurfacing but no final head-height/material-removal bound in this section; automated resurfacing approval excluded. Replacement head also requires valves per source.
Cover crankcase opening before clip removal; do not hammer pin. Deburr pin groove/bore area; pin puller90890-01304/YU-01304 if needed.

Cylinder C is maximum of six two-axis/three-height measurements. Piston measured9.0 mm from skirt bottom. Use actual C minus measured piston diameter; retain source clearance0.010–0.045 mm and limit0.15 mm distinctly. Do not infer a safe fit merely from individual component ranges.

Clean grooves/rings before side-clearance measure; square ring near bottom with piston crown for end-gap check. Oil expander end gap cannot be measured; excessive rail gap means replace oil-ring set. Top/end gap limits0.55/0.85 mm are wear limits, not ring-filing installation targets.

Oil expander, lower rail, upper rail, second ring, top ring; marks/numbers face upward. Oil piston/pin; piston mark points toward exhaust(REAR). Use NEW clips, gap end away from piston cutout, cloth blocks crankcase. Source-specific ring clocking diagram must be preserved; no generic120-degree rule. New base gasket/dowels; compress rings while lowering cylinder, pass chain and exhaust-side guide through cavity; cylinder bolt10 N·m.

open_evidence_questions.detail: Two small head bolts specify LOCTITE with no grade/application details in inspected section. Resolve exact product/applicability before novice runnable head-refit instructions.

Individual standard ranges cylinder97.000–97.010 mm and piston96.955–96.970 mm can mathematically yield0.030–0.055 mm, while source separately specifies assembled clearance0.010–0.045 mm. Preserve both; use actual measured clearance and do not declare every individually in-range pair acceptable.

Reviewed piston section shows top/second ring end-gap wear limits; exact standard top/second/rail installation gaps must be reconciled with earlier spec table before a complete rebuild instruction. Do not turn maximum wear values into targets.

release_decision: Do not publish a complete top-end or motor rebuild from these core pages. Retain this dependency checkpoint and continue the missing access, fluid, head-valve and fit decisions.
